CEVA Logistics competes globally with major third-party logistics and freight-forwarding providers. Its top primary competitors include **DHL Supply Chain**, **DSV**, **Kuehne + Nagel**, **UPS Supply Chain Solutions**, and **FedEx Logistics**. [](https://www.gartner.com/reviews/market/third-party-logistics/vendor/ceva-logistics/alternatives)

- **DHL Supply Chain:** Massive global contract logistics and warehousing footprint.

- **DSV:** Large international transport and logistics network specializing in global freight.

- **Kuehne + Nagel:** Market leader in sea and air freight forwarding.

- **UPS Supply Chain Solutions:** Extensive North American and global air/ocean freight and logistics services.

- **FedEx Logistics:** Global supply chain, brokerage, and transportation services.

- **XPO Logistics:** Strong competitor focused heavily on less-than-truckload (LTL) shipping in North America. [](https://www.gartner.com/reviews/market/third-party-logistics/vendor/ceva-logistics/alternatives)
